name: Candied Oblivion 2: Creamy Dreamy
source:
A sequel that leans into magical elements of Candied Oblivion. The most fantastic events and possibilities are assumed, so the game starts with you living with Grace and Grace as a throuple.

[From [url=https://thesugarray.itch.io/thesugarrays-demo-disk]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
续集偏向《Candied Oblivion》的魔法元素。假设了最奇妙的事件和可能性，所以游戏从你与格蕾丝和格蕾丝作为一个三人生活在一起开始。

[来自[url=https://thesugarray.itch.io/thesugarrays-demo-disk]itch.io[/url]]
